name: Standard KYC, custom fraud prevention (example)
desc: Per-level Fraud Prevention override: the advanced IP check is off for this level and the advanced email check is pinned on, while phone, identity enrichment and device intelligence are omitted and take the client-wide defaults. On a tenant moved to client-wide fraud prevention those defaults start as false, so omitted means off there: read them first with scripts/get_level_fraud_prevention.sh (no argument). useCustomFraudPreventionSettings must be true or the whole object is ignored. When updating a level that already has an override, start from its current fraudPreventionSettings: PATCH replaces the whole object. Read the result back with scripts/get_level_fraud_prevention.sh <level name>.
